description: Retired American teacher Ronald Sakolsky reunited with his Chinese friend in China's Henan. Sakolsky raised 5,000 U.S. dollars to fund her afforestation work. #Reunion #Luoyang #Heartwarming #Friendship #ClimateAction #RonaldSakolsky

description: A themed light show at China's Tianjin Radio and Television Tower paid tribute to the decades-long friendship between U.S. teacher Ronald Sakolsky and Chinese anti-desertification hero Yin Yuzhen. author: New China TV
description:
Rescue teams are hurrying to mudslide-hit Gyirong Port, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region.
Roads, power and communications have been cut off.
The mudslide occurred on Wednesday morning in Nepal, resulting in three people dead and 265 others missing at Gyirong Port as of 8 p.m., according to initial estimates.
Xinhua is on site in Gyirong, bringing you the latest news on the rescue efforts.
#OnSite #Xizang #Gyirong #Rescue #Mudslide #China
title: On-site in Gyirong | Rescuers rush to mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

author: New China TV
description:
A directing group from the Western Theater Command of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) has been dispatched to the Xizang Autonomous Region in southwest China on Thursday morning to coordinate joint rescue operations by military personnel in mudslide-hit Gyirong County.
Carried by the Y-20 transport aircraft of the western theater command, the group will organize military forces to assist in disaster relief efforts.
The mudslide, which occurred on Wednesday, has resulted in three people dead and 265 missing in Gyirong, according to initial estimates.
title: PLA sends group to coordinate rescue efforts in mudslide-hit county in SW China's Xizang

The plane took off from Chengdu early Thursday morning, and has now landed at Dingri Airport in Shigatse.
title: China dispatched 111 emergency rescuers to mudslide-stricken Gyirong Port
